reportTitle: LimbPlay Track B Clinical Kinematics & Motor Matrix Report

metricDefinitionsGlossary.Completion Time (MT): Movement Time elapsed from sustained kinematic onset (velocity >= 0.045 units/s) until final target arrival or grasp completion.
metricDefinitionsGlossary.Initiation / Reaction Latency: Latency from visual stimulus spawn until the participant first initiates hand movement towards the target.
metricDefinitionsGlossary.Trajectory Smoothness: 0 to 1 normalized metric combining straight-line path directness and normalized dimensionless jerk. Higher values indicate smooth, coordinated, bell-shaped velocity profiles.
metricDefinitionsGlossary.Velocity (Avg & Peak): Speed of hand movement in normalized workspace units per second, filtered with a 3-point moving average to eliminate vision micro-jitter.
metricDefinitionsGlossary.Corrective Movements: Count of submovement velocity peaks (prominence >= 12% peak velocity) where the subject hesitated or made secondary trajectory corrections, plus task error contacts (partition collisions).
